text.p: Shares in Hungarian chemicals company TVK tumbled some 15 percent in early trading on Friday, following the release of its preliminary 1996 results.
TVK shares opened at 2,285 forints, down from Thursday's close of 2,620 forints. At 1104 GMT it traded at 2,235.
"The link between TVK's fall and the results is evident," one trader said.
"Nevertheless, I don't fully understand why it's falling so sharply as expectations of its results were not very good anyway."
TVK reported a net income of 7.76 billion forints on net sales of 62.01 billion forints in 1996 against a net income of 10.47 billion on sales of 60.67 billion in 1995.
The market's other chemical company Borsodchem also moved downward after the publication of its 1996 earnings but the pace of fall was slower.
Borsodchem opened at 6,130 forints, below Thursday's last price of 6,350 and at 1110 GMT it traded at 6,050.
